sloka: ततस्तं राक्षसा दृष्ट्वा निर्विचेष्टमरिन्दमम् ।बबन्धुः शणवल्कैश्च द्रुमचीरैश्च संहतैः ।। ५.४८.४७।।।।
transliteration: tatastaṁ rākṣasā dṛṣṭvā nirviceṣṭamarindamam ।babandhuḥ śaṇavalkaiśca drumacīraiśca saṁhataiḥ ।। 5.48.47।।।।

translations.english: Bound by the enemy warriors, Hanuman, decided to bear all humiliations, thinking, 'May be the demon king might come to see me out of curiosity if he is so disposed'.
